title: Priority Queues
description: Priority Queues is a scheduling ability in the Autonomous Task Scheduling Queues database. Orders tasks by priority with strict ordering guarantees. Tasks carry an integer priority; the scheduler always dequeues the highest available. It takes tasks and produces ordered execution. Tunable parameters: integer priority. Guarantee: a higher-priority ready task never waits behind a lower one.

fields.mechanism: Tasks carry an integer priority; the scheduler always dequeues the highest available.
fields.guarantees: a higher-priority ready task never waits behind a lower one

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Deadline Scheduling
description: Deadline Scheduling is a scheduling ability in the Autonomous Task Scheduling Queues database. Schedules by earliest deadline first for time-critical work. Deadlines sort the ready queue; missed deadlines are reported, not hidden. It takes deadlines and produces EDF order. Tunable parameters: per task. Guarantee: missed deadlines always alert.

fields.mechanism: Deadlines sort the ready queue; missed deadlines are reported, not hidden.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Dependency Graphs
description: Dependency Graphs is a scheduling ability in the Autonomous Task Scheduling Queues database. Runs tasks only after their dependencies complete. Dependencies form a DAG; a task becomes ready when all its parents succeed. It takes DAG and produces ready tasks. Tunable parameters: acyclic. Guarantee: a task never runs before its parents.

fields.mechanism: Dependencies form a DAG; a task becomes ready when all its parents succeed.
fields.guarantees: a task never runs before its parents

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Worker Pools
description: Worker Pools is a scheduling ability in the Autonomous Task Scheduling Queues database. Distributes tasks across a pool of workers with heartbeats. Workers lease tasks; dead workers' leases expire and the tasks return to the queue. It takes workers and produces assigned tasks. Tunable parameters: lease 60 s. Guarantee: no task is ever lost to a dead worker.

fields.mechanism: Workers lease tasks; dead workers' leases expire and the tasks return to the queue.
fields.guarantees: no task is ever lost to a dead worker

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Retry Policies
description: Retry Policies is a scheduling ability in the Autonomous Task Scheduling Queues database. Retries failed tasks with exponential backoff and a cap. Failures requeue with delay 2^n seconds up to 5 tries, then move to dead-letter. It takes failures and produces retries. Tunable parameters: max 5. Guarantee: retries never exceed the cap.

fields.mechanism: Failures requeue with delay 2^n seconds up to 5 tries, then move to dead-letter.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Dead-Letter Queues
description: Dead-Letter Queues is a scheduling ability in the Autonomous Task Scheduling Queues database. Parks repeatedly failing tasks for inspection. After max retries the task moves to dead-letter with its full error history. It takes failures and produces parked tasks. Tunable parameters: with history. Guarantee: dead-letter tasks are never auto-retried.

fields.mechanism: After max retries the task moves to dead-letter with its full error history.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Fair Sharing
description: Fair Sharing is a scheduling ability in the Autonomous Task Scheduling Queues database. Shares workers fairly across tenants. Each tenant gets a weighted share of worker time; over-quota tenants wait. It takes tenants and produces shares. Tunable parameters: weighted. Guarantee: one tenant never starves another.

fields.mechanism: Each tenant gets a weighted share of worker time; over-quota tenants wait.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Scheduled Triggers
description: Scheduled Triggers is a scheduling ability in the Autonomous Task Scheduling Queues database. Fires tasks on cron-like schedules. Schedules are parsed and the next fire time computed; missed fires are caught up once. It takes schedules and produces fired tasks. Tunable parameters: cron. Guarantee: a schedule never fires twice for one tick.

fields.mechanism: Schedules are parsed and the next fire time computed; missed fires are caught up once.
fields.guarantees: a schedule never fires twice for one tick

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Task Deduplication
description: Task Deduplication is a scheduling ability in the Autonomous Task Scheduling Queues database. Merges duplicate queued tasks into one. Tasks with the same dedup key collapse; the merged task carries all requesters. It takes queued tasks and produces merged tasks. Tunable parameters: by key. Guarantee: requesters are all notified.

fields.mechanism: Tasks with the same dedup key collapse; the merged task carries all requesters.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Progress Tracking
description: Progress Tracking is a scheduling ability in the Autonomous Task Scheduling Queues database. Tracks each task from queued to done with timestamps. State transitions append to the task record; the dashboard shows live counts. It takes tasks and produces states. Tunable parameters: queued→done. Guarantee: transitions are never skipped.

fields.mechanism: State transitions append to the task record; the dashboard shows live counts.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Cancellation
description: Cancellation is a scheduling ability in the Autonomous Task Scheduling Queues database. Cancels queued or running tasks cleanly. Cancel sets a flag; workers check it between steps and stop, releasing the lease. It takes task id and produces cancelled task. Tunable parameters: cooperative. Guarantee: cancelled tasks never bill.

fields.mechanism: Cancel sets a flag; workers check it between steps and stop, releasing the lease.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Result Storage
description: Result Storage is a scheduling ability in the Autonomous Task Scheduling Queues database. Stores task results with the task record for later fetch. Results write to the record on completion with a TTL; fetchers read by task id. It takes results and produces stored results. Tunable parameters: TTL 7 d. Guarantee: results are never stored without their task.

fields.mechanism: Results write to the record on completion with a TTL; fetchers read by task id.
fields.guarantees: results are never stored without their task

title: Backpressure
description: Backpressure is a scheduling ability in the Autonomous Task Scheduling Queues database. Slows producers when queues grow too long. Queue depth over the high watermark rejects new tasks with retry-after. It takes queue depth and produces rejections. Tunable parameters: watermark. Guarantee: rejections always include retry-after.

fields.mechanism: Queue depth over the high watermark rejects new tasks with retry-after.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Maintenance Windows
description: Maintenance Windows is a scheduling ability in the Autonomous Task Scheduling Queues database. Pauses scheduling during maintenance windows. Windows are declared in advance; running tasks drain and new ones wait. It takes windows and produces paused scheduler. Tunable parameters: declared. Guarantee: in-flight tasks always finish first.

fields.mechanism: Windows are declared in advance; running tasks drain and new ones wait.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Audit Log
description: Audit Log is a scheduling ability in the Autonomous Task Scheduling Queues database. Logs every scheduling decision for replay. Enqueue, assign, complete, and fail events append to an immutable log. It takes events and produces log. Tunable parameters: immutable. Guarantee: the log never drops an event.

fields.mechanism: Enqueue, assign, complete, and fail events append to an immutable log.
fields.guarantees: the log never drops an event
